pictures.viewed: Overhead full-resolution view. The upper eastern ruin along the curved perimeter path has an outer rim, concentric inner edging and an exposed center. The strongest break is on the side toward the villa. Approximate heights and small-scale remains are inferred.

currentRoundInspection.scope: Surviving uncovered octagonal masonry beside the Villa Romana del Casale basilica. A broad low outer rim and smaller inner rim surround an open center, with an approximate opening toward the villa. Other villa buildings are separate landmarks.
